phase.name: IntegralPlace.phase
phase.statement:
def IntegralPlace.phase g z := if h : ∃ u ∈ T.besselU,
  u⁻¹ * z ∈ unitaryLevel R g _ then P.ψ (g⁻¹.1 * simpleRootSum h.choose) else 0

existsbesselUofphasenezero.name: IntegralPlace.exists_besselU_of_phase_ne_zero
existsbesselUofphasenezero.statement:
lemma IntegralPlace.exists_besselU_of_phase_ne_zero : phase g y ≠ 0 → ∃ u ∈ besselU,
  u⁻¹ * y ∈ unitaryLevel R g _

phaseeq.name: IntegralPlace.phase_eq
phaseeq.statement:
lemma IntegralPlace.phase_eq (hu : u ∈ besselU) (e : u⁻¹ * y ∈ unitaryLevel R g _) : phase g y =
  P.ψ (g⁻¹.1 * simpleRootSum u)

phasebesselSmul.name: IntegralPlace.phase_besselS_mul
phasebesselSmul.statement:
lemma IntegralPlace.phase_besselS_mul (hx : x ∈ besselS) (hu : u ∈ besselU) (f :
  u⁻¹ * x ∈ unitaryLevel R g _) : phase g (x * y) = ψ (g⁻¹ * simpleRootSum u) * phase g y

phasemulofmemunitaryLevel.name: IntegralPlace.phase_mul_of_mem_unitaryLevel
phasemulofmemunitaryLevel.statement:
lemma IntegralPlace.phase_mul_of_mem_unitaryLevel (hk : k ∈ unitaryLevel R g _) : phase g (y * k) =
  phase g y

phasebesselUmul.name: IntegralPlace.phase_besselU_mul
phasebesselUmul.statement:
lemma IntegralPlace.phase_besselU_mul (hu : u ∈ besselU) : phase g (u * y) = ψ (g⁻¹ * simpleRootSum
  u) * phase g y

unitaryLevelleunitaryLevelone.name: IntegralPlace.unitaryLevel_le_unitaryLevel_one
unitaryLevelleunitaryLevelone.statement:
lemma IntegralPlace.unitaryLevel_le_unitaryLevel_one : unitaryLevel R g T.splitGram ≤
  unitaryLevel R 1 _

IntermediateGroup.name: Level.IntermediateGroup
IntermediateGroup.statement: abbrev Level.IntermediateGroup (F : Level ι T (m + 1)) := ↥(Icc F.congGroup (unitaryLevel R 1 _))

unipotentMass.name: Level.unipotentMass
unipotentMass.statement: abbrev Level.unipotentMass (F : Level ι T (m + 1)) := ∏ l ∈ .range 𝔰.ϱ, F.floorModulus l

floorZeroForm.name: Level.floorZeroForm
floorZeroForm.statement:
def Level.floorZeroForm (Z : Subgroup T.G) := ∫⁻ x, ‖∫ y in Z,
  phase F.g (y * x * y⁻¹) ∂F.groupMeasure‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂F.groupMeasure

massRatio.name: Level.IntermediateGroup.massRatio
massRatio.statement:
def Level.IntermediateGroup.massRatio (Z : F.IntermediateGroup) :=
  F.groupMeasure Z * F.groupMeasure F.congGroup / F.unipotentMass ^ 2

besselVector.name: Level.IntermediateGroup.besselVector
besselVector.statement:
def Level.IntermediateGroup.besselVector (Z : F.IntermediateGroup) (y : T.G) :
  EuclideanSpace ℂ Z.Cosets := .toLp 2 fun c ↦ phase F.g (y * c.out.1⁻¹)

existsofinnerbesselVectornezero.name: Level.exists_of_inner_besselVector_ne_zero
existsofinnerbesselVectornezero.statement:
lemma Level.exists_of_inner_besselVector_ne_zero (Z : F.IntermediateGroup) (e : ⟪Z.besselVector x,
  Z.besselVector y⟫_ℂ ≠ 0) : ∃ u ∈ besselU, ∃ v ∈ besselU, u * x ∈ unitaryLevel R 1 _ ∧
  (u * x)⁻¹ * (v * y) ∈ F.congGroup

existscoset.name: Level.IntermediateGroup.exists_coset
existscoset.statement:
lemma Level.IntermediateGroup.exists_coset {F : Level ι T (m + 1)} (Z : F.IntermediateGroup) (a :
  y ∈ Z.1) : ∃ d, ∀ c : Z.Cosets, y * c.out.1⁻¹ ∈
  F.congGroup ↔ c = d

groupMeasurenetop.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.groupMeasure_ne_top
groupMeasurenetop.statement: lemma groupMeasure_ne_top {S} (e : S ≤ unitaryLevel R 1 T.splitGram) : F.groupMeasure S ≠ ∞

floorZeroFormoncongGroup.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.floorZeroForm_on_congGroup
floorZeroFormoncongGroup.statement:
lemma floorZeroForm_on_congGroup : ∫⁻ x in F.congGroup, ‖∫ y in Z, phase F.g (y * x * y⁻¹)
  ∂F.groupMeasure‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂F.groupMeasure = F.groupMeasure Z ^ 2 * F.groupMeasure F.congGroup

unipotentMassmulinnerbesselVector.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.unipotentMass_mul_inner_besselVector
unipotentMassmulinnerbesselVector.statement:
lemma unipotentMass_mul_inner_besselVector y x : F.unipotentMass.toReal * ⟪Z.besselVector y,
  Z.besselVector (y * x)⟫_ℂ = ∫ u, indicator Z
  (fun z ↦ phase F.g (z * x * z⁻¹)) (u * y) ∂ascConv heisenbergMeasure (𝔰.ϱ + 2)

pairingNormmullemassRatio.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.pairingNorm_mul_le_massRatio
pairingNormmullemassRatio.statement:
lemma pairingNorm_mul_le_massRatio : F.pairingNorm Z.besselVector Z.besselVector * F.unipotentMass ≤
  Z.massRatio

enormintegralphaseequpperPairing.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.enorm_integral_phase_eq_upperPairing
enormintegralphaseequpperPairing.statement:
lemma enorm_integral_phase_eq_upperPairing : ‖∫ y in Z, phase F.g (y * x * y⁻¹) ∂F.groupMeasure‖ₑ =
  ‖F.upperPairing 0 (translatePairing Z.besselVector Z.besselVector 1) 1 x‖ₑ * F.unipotentMass

invtwopowlegroupMeasure.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.inv_two_pow_le_groupMeasure
invtwopowlegroupMeasure.statement:
lemma inv_two_pow_le_groupMeasure {B} (hB : 2 ≤ B ∧ volume (P.R \ P.intUnits) ≤ B⁻¹) : 2⁻¹ ^ 𝔰.n ≤
  F.groupMeasure (unitaryLevel R 1 T.splitGram)

existsunitmemfloorValues.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.exists_unit_mem_floorValues
existsunitmemfloorValues.statement:
lemma exists_unit_mem_floorValues a {z} y (e : ⟪Z.besselVector x, Z.besselVector z⟫_ℂ ≠ 0) : ∃ c :
    Aˣ, c.1 ∈ R ∧ ↑c ∈ F.floorValues a x y ∧ volume (F.floorValues a x y) ≤ P.md c

existscloseofinnernezero.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.exists_close_of_inner_ne_zero
existscloseofinnernezero.statement:
lemma exists_close_of_inner_ne_zero (e : ⟪Z.besselVector x, Z.besselVector y⟫_ℂ ≠ 0) :
  ∃ u ∈ besselU, ∃ v ∈ besselU, u * x ∈ F.boxSet ∧ v * y ∈ F.boxSet ∧ Γ.HasMatSize 2
  (F.g⁻¹.1 • ((v * y).1.1 - (u * x).1.1))

lintegralshellsle.statement:

lintegralformMajorantnetop.name: IntegralPlace.IsStdLevel.lintegral_formMajorant_ne_top
lintegralformMajorantnetop.statement:
lemma lintegral_formMajorant_ne_top : ∫⁻ x,

enormfloorFormle.statement:
lemma enorm_floorForm_le {ω} (hK : 10 ^ 10 * 𝔰.n ^ 4 ≤ K)
    (H : (ω = fun x ↦ P.ψ (ξ * (T.frameGram x.1.1).diag ⟨j, by lia⟩)) ∨ ∃ i, j = i + 1 ∧ ω = 1 ∧ ξ =

floorZeroFormlemainterm.statement:
lemma floorZeroForm_le_main_term : F.floorZeroForm Z ≤ F.groupMeasure Z * F.groupMeasure
  F.congGroup * (F.groupMeasure Z + volume (P.R \ P.intUnits) ^ (t + 1) * 2⁻¹ ^ 𝔰.n)

correlation.name: Level.correlation
correlation.statement:
def Level.correlation l := (F.headDensity 𝔰.ϱ p 1).toReal • besselCorrelation F.groupMeasure
  Z.besselVector (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ p * l⁻¹)

topKernel.name: Level.topKernel
topKernel.statement:
def Level.topKernel := ∫ l in {l | T.frameGram ↑l⁻¹ 𝔰.top 𝔰.top - p 𝔰.ϱ ∈ L}, ⟪correlation Z p l,
  correlation Z q l⟫_ℂ ∂F.stackMeasure 𝔰.ϱ 2

energya.name: Level.energy
energya.statement:
def Level.energy := ⨅ (l) (_ : l ∈ GT 𝔰.ϱ ∧ orbitPoint 𝔰.top l = e), ∫⁻ h, ∑ x,
  let v p := correlation Z (ω p) (h * l) x; .ofReal (star v ⬝ᵥ R *ᵥ v).re ∂F.measureH

existsgaugeisHead.statement: lemma exists_gauge_isHead : ∃ Γ : Gauge F, ∀ j, ∀ᶠ r in nhds (![p, q] j), Γ.IsHead 𝔰.ϱ r

eventuallycorrelationeq.statement:
